notes.title: Space Ops VR is now available to all FARHOME owners!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045110/Space_Ops_VR/
Hello friends!

First of all, we would like to apologize for such a delayed response from our team. Unfortunately, some legal aspects did not allow us to give any comments regarding FARHOME game. We have read all comments and we understand your feelings.

It is, therefore, a great pleasure for us to share with you the following news. 

1.We have solved all legal issues related to FARHOME game.

2. As you probably have noticed, some assets were already used in Space Ops VR. Now we can bring most of FARHOME content to Space Ops VR. It means that you will see the single-player content in Space Ops VR! We are now porting FARHOME missions and soon we will start adding the brand new ones.

3. Space Ops VR will combine two projects. There won't be any further development of FARHOME game and we are sorry about it but we have great news for all who own FARHOME. 

4. All of you who already bought FARHOME will get a copy of Space Ops VR for free. 
Please check your game library.

Prepare for the next battle!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E90_y_SlQZI

notes.title: BLOG #3
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We apologize for the silence. There was a little force majeure, but fortunately all is sorted out now. For reasons beyond our control, there had been a power outage at the office we rented.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/d6e72a688a1a9112c69eb5bf6aa7c1e59fe3c3fd.jpg[/img]

We hastily relocated to a new office. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/6d6440ece0ff29c9d4b90bc3402ccfc2facbaf07.jpg[/img]

It is quite an adventure – starting from such simple things as kitchen and toilet, and ending with servers, Internet access and building communications throughout the office.
Not everything is working as it should, but pretty much everything is back on track.

So, what we are preparing in the next update:
[list]
[*]a small correction that will balance different types of movement in the game
[*]system of achievement accruing improved
[*]saving of settings in the Steam Cloud added
[*]a new system of movement in space added for those who do not like smooth movement
[/list]  
We continue working on the script – additional touches have been added to the story. 3 new missions are being prepared; work on maps and game mechanics prototypes has been launched. 

We plan to release large updates quarterly. We will give you more details about what exactly will be included in them later.

In addition, we plan to pay more attention to training new players. To do this, we will make a system of interactive tips in weapons and slightly improve the training level. We want players to use the entire arsenal of weapons and special abilities of the characters.

In about 2-3 weeks, we plan to enter the following platforms – Oculus and Viveport. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/a17249b4a201415595e9f31fecdcb823c35175c6.jpg[/img]
 
Hi, friends!
We are happy to introduce the first update! 

Its main feature is the ability to change controls:
- Locomotion Swap is added. Now you can swap Move and Turn for controllers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/bb8b76648239247088ffdf89c210b4a975beb9a2.jpg[/img]

- Move and Turn parameters can be fine tuned now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/c9e7e44f5f5b2d75ad89c7b16bf8b70174fe4977.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/3f6e7c38f1b27ac1551abe55727997835c194109.jpg[/img]

We tried to take into account all your suggestions and not to ruin existing game mechanism as well. We plan to release a game guide on controls soon in which we’ll tell you about all the features. 

Subtitles’ transparency and position adjustments are also available now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32388084/558e4ede28f9c33e08819b4077f04f6b78f44add.jpg[/img]

We are waiting for your comments on our discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/phUS8ze] DISCORD [/url]   and in community discussions.
